section_role: Texture editing, material generation, and animation module methods and results

method_evidence.claim: Text-guided texture editing model trained on 80k high-quality 3D assets with PBR materials.
method_evidence.anchor: trained on a meticulously curated dataset of 80k high-quality 3D assets with PBR materials

method_evidence.claim: Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture for image-guided texture editing uses CLIP similarity to decide feature injection method.
method_evidence.anchor: compute the CLIP similarity between geometrically rendered views and the input image. If the guidance image exhibits high geometric correspondence... inject image features via a VAE encoder; otherwise, we use CLIP image embeddings

method_evidence.claim: 3D VAE framework adapted to compress multi-domain material data into unified latent representations for 4K texture synthesis.
method_evidence.anchor: adapt the 3D VAE framework... to compress multi-domain material data (renders, base color, bump, roughness, metallic, etc.) into unified latent representations

method_evidence.claim: Humanoid branch uses template-based auto-rigging with 22 body joints and a pose standardization module to T-pose.
method_evidence.anchor: adopt 22 body joints as the template skeleton... includes a pose standardization module that converts user-provided models in arbitrary poses into a canonical T-pose

method_evidence.claim: General branch integrates autoregressive skeleton generation with geometry topology-aware skinning.
method_evidence.anchor: general branch integrates an autoregressive skeleton generation module with a geometry topology-aware skinning module

experiment_evidence.claim: Training details for humanoid auto-rigging and skinning module.
experiment_evidence.value: batch size 6 on 8 H20 GPUs for 3 days

experiment_evidence.claim: Training details for general-purpose rigging module.
experiment_evidence.value: batch size 16 on 24 H20 GPUs for 2 days

experiment_evidence.claim: Training details for general-purpose skinning module.
experiment_evidence.value: batch size 16 on 8 GPUs for 2 days
